title: WHAT’S UNDER THE GRATE? 😨
topic: suspenseful discovery in a hidden floor chamber

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Nix, get back! The sensors are turning bright red [beat] and there’s something heavy breathing down there in the dark!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I can't just leave it, Riku! That grating looks like it hasn't been opened in fifty years [beat] but the lock is still burning hot.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Will you two stop messing with that? Dad is coming up the stairs right now and if he sees that trapdoor [beat] we are all dead meat!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Wait, look at the tablet screen! The thermal camera is picking up a human shape [beat] but it’s way too small to be an adult.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It’s not a person, look at the way it moves! It’s a series of clockwork gears [beat] holding up a massive, glowing blue orb.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I told you kids a thousand times to stay away from the north wing of the attic! Step away from that grate [beat] before it’s too late!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Dad, what is this place? You’ve been hiding an entire power source under the floorboards [beat] while the rest of the city is in a blackout!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: It is not just a power source, Nix. It’s a family legacy that you were never supposed to see [beat] until your eighteenth birthday.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The metal is vibrating! Something is trying to push the grate open from the inside [beat] and it sounds like a high-pitched scream!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: The attic walls are starting to crack! Whatever is in there is feeding off the house's energy [beat] and we need to run out of here now!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I’m not running! If we don’t close that safety valve, the whole neighborhood is going to get [beat] sucked right into this void!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: As the floor begins to collapse, the kids realize the attic isn't just a room [beat] it is the main engine of the entire house.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The blue light is blinding me! Riku, grab my hand because I think the hidden chamber [beat] is starting to pull us inside!
